newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's proven oil reserves 9 bln bbls by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's proven oil reserves 9 bln bbls by 2000.

text.p: Colombia's proven oil reserves are expected to almost triple, reaching 9 billion barrels by the year 2000, President Ernesto Samper announced Wednesday.
Samper was speaking in the eastern oil-producing province of Casanare. Current proven reserves stand at 3.5 billion barrels.
Two weeks ago, Energy and Mines Minister Rodrigo Villamizar said proven crude oil reserves were expected to reach at least 15 billion barrels within the next 50 years.

The source of Samper's forecast was not immediately clear. But in September he surprised oil industry officials by announcing that the recently-discovered Coporo field was the biggest find in Colombia since the giant Cusiana block in the eastern plains was discovered in the late 1980s.
